user.title: Connect the technology-system controller
user.description: Connect to the MC7021 local TCP/9000 service.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the technology-system controller
reconfigure.description: Change the controller address or local credentials without removing existing entities.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate the technology-system controller
reauth_confirm.description: The controller rejected the existing credentials. Enter the local username and password; the integration reloads automatically after validation.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect or log in to the controller
error.handshake_failed: The controller did not complete the protocol handshake. Check the controller model and TCP port 9000 service.
error.login_timeout: The controller login response timed out. Check controller availability and local credentials.
error.invalid_auth: The controller rejected the login. Check the local controller username and password.
error.protocol_incompatible: The controller returned a protocol response unsupported by this integration.
error.invalid_config: Invalid client ID or technology-system MAC
error.unknown: Unexpected error; check the Home Assistant log

abort.reauth_successful: The local controller credentials were updated
abort.reconfigure_successful: The local controller configuration was updated

login_timeout.title: Technology-system controller login timed out repeatedly

init.title: Reauthenticate local controller credentials
init.description: The controller has not completed login three times in a row. Check that it is online, TCP port 9000, and the local username and password. Submitting opens the credential verification flow for this config entry.

abort.entry_not_found: The associated config entry could not be found

init.title: Try reconnecting to the controller
init.description: The controller returned a protocol response unsupported by this version. After confirming firmware compatibility, submit to reload this integration and try again.

abort.entry_not_found: The associated config entry could not be found

command_timeout.title: Technology-system commands were not confirmed repeatedly
command_timeout.description: The controller did not confirm three consecutive commands. Check connection stability, avoid reusing one account across clients, and review command queue and confirmation counters in integration diagnostics. The issue clears after the next confirmed command.

system_fault.title: Controller fault
system_fault.description: The controller reported raw controller fault code {code}. This integration has no reliable vendor code definitions and cannot determine the specific cause. Check the technology-system equipment and controller, and contact property or equipment maintenance staff if needed. This issue clears automatically when the controller reports raw code 0.

filter_fault.title: Fresh-air filter fault
filter_fault.description: The controller reported raw fresh-air filter fault code {code}. Check the fresh-air filter according to its maintenance instructions; this integration does not guess the code's specific meaning. This issue clears automatically when the controller reports raw code 0.

stale_panel.title: Room thermostat panel has not reported for 30 days

confirm.title: Remove stale room thermostat panel
confirm.description: {room} ({short_mac}) has not sent a valid report since {last_report}. This action removes only this integration's panel entities and stored panel record; it does not delete Home Assistant automations. Cancel leaves everything unchanged. A future report from the same panel will be discovered again.

abort.entry_not_found: The associated config entry could not be found
abort.entry_not_loaded: The associated integration is not currently loaded
abort.panel_no_longer_stale: This panel reported again or is no longer eligible for removal. No changes were made.
